item.title: Govt Issues New Conditions for PAYE, VAT, and Income Tax Reduction
item.description: Kenyans could likely be forced to wait longer before they can reap the effects of the proposed reduction if the conditions are not met.

item.title: Governor Reveals Start Date for SGR Extension Linking 6 Counties
item.description: The announcement comes days after Kenya Railways outlined measures it will implement while acquiring land for the rail line.

item.title: State House Cries Foul as Grabbers Encroach on Its Land
item.description: The enchroachment according to State House officials, has put the security of the president at risk and other dignitaries visiting at risk.

item.title: ODM Kicks Out Rebel MPs From Key House Committees
item.description: The changes come at a time when tensions continue to rock the Orange Party ahead of the 2027 elections.

item.title: Inside Plans to Make Changes to KUCCPS Students' Placement
item.description: The changes would see the powers and control of KUCCPS over the sector taken away by the Ministry, which is currently in charge of administration.

item.title: Omtatah Drags NTSA to Senate Over Spike in Road Deaths
item.description: NTSA is on the spot once again, from the lost of 70,000 number plates funds, to being held accountable for the rising number of road accidents in the country.

item.title: Babu Owino Decries Harassment After Security Detail Allegedly Arrested
item.description: This comes against the backdrop of Babu Owino's brother-in-law and member of his security detail being arrested last week, and his security personnel being detained at Kisumu Police Station ahead of the Linda Mwananachi rally in Kakamega.

item.title: Kenya Votes for Major UN Resolution Against Russia as U.S. and Several African Countries Abstain
item.description: The voting comes amid plans by PCS Mudavadi to visit Russia in March to negotiate and engage the Kremlin on diplomatic steps to release Kenyans from the battlefields.

item.title: Treasury Gives Status Update on Multi-Billion Nairobi-Mombasa Expressway
item.description: The Nairobi-Mombasa Expressway is listed as a priority project under Kenya’s Medium-Term Plan and is expected to significantly cut travel time between the two cities.

item.title: LSK President-Elect Calls for the Introduction of New Police Unit
item.description: Kanjama says that he will have an engagement with the Inspector General of Police, Douglas Kanja, and the Chief Justice, Martha Koome, to deliberate on the matter.
